## Goal
Improve readability and identity with optional character images and richer cards.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add optional image field to character model.
- [ ] Show image in team slots and rotation rows.
- [ ] Add fallback styled initial avatar.
- [ ] Support user-provided URL/upload images stored browser-side.
- [ ] Add optional Enka `/ui/hsr/` image path support after terms review.
- [ ] Build character card + relic grid layout.
- [ ] Ensure no proprietary game art is committed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Image fallback works for missing/failed URLs.
- [ ] User image configuration persists across reload.
- [ ] Layout remains usable on mobile and desktop.
